confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on a few web searches: crowdsourced cost-of-living indexes (Numbeo-style), nomad and travel blogs, expat price guides for Phuket and Pattaya, and 7-Eleven shelf prices. These sources are undated or from mixed years, and they disagree, so restaurant and drink figures are bounded estimates. Cocktail and wine anchors are derived from the local beer relationship and general descriptions of Pai bars, not from direct price evidence. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Pai context; no accommodation search was run and no live listings were checked. The FX observation (0.6720 for 2026-11-18) came from search-result snippets that attribute it to the RBA, and I did not open the rba.gov.au page, so verify it against the RBA F11.1 table before use. Prices are estimated for a July 2026 window.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Pai-specific web sources, cross-checked against Northern Thai small-town tourism pricing and Thai tourist-town restaurant and bar norms. Accommodation tiers are a model estimate for a small Northern Thai backpacker and resort town.
